title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents

beats.text: Before you choose your foundation model, look at how HexaShell beats the leader by 98.2%.
beats.visual_focus: A robot arm twitching and dropping a block in a messy workspace.

visual_blueprint.title: THE REALITY GAP
visual_blueprint.sub: Why coding agents struggle with gravity

motif_params.title: THE REALITY GAP
motif_params.sub: Why coding agents struggle with gravity

beats.text: The villain is the contact barrier. Your code is perfect, but the robot's gripper lacks the finesse for tight insertion.
beats.visual_focus: A split screen showing clean code on the left and a failed, jittery robot insertion on the right.

beats.text: HexaShell shatters this by keeping the harness thin, turning VLM commands directly into motion via iterative tool-writing.
beats.visual_focus: A diagram showing a VLM outputting code that generates a motion trajectory.

beats.text: It uses triangulation from three RGB cameras, moving the wrist camera to resolve spatial uncertainty when head views fail.
